title: loopLifecycle
responsibility: Registers CLI commands for listing open loops and explicitly closing a loop as abandoned, including input validation and user-facing output.

inputs.name: registerLoopLifecycleCommands.command
inputs.description: The Commander command that the `list` and `close <loop>` subcommands are attached to during registration. The function never checks its type; it relies on Commander's command() method and the chained option(), description() and action() calls that follow it.

outputs.name: registerLoopLifecycleCommands
outputs.description: The function returns nothing and is synchronous; its effect is the `list` and `close <loop>` subcommands attached to the supplied command before it returns. The actions are only passed to action() here and are not run during this call.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised through fail() by the registered actions when `close` runs without --abandoned, or when a supplied --stale value does not convert with Number() to a non-negative safe integer; the registration call itself never raises it. Rejections from listOpenLoops and closeLoopAbandoned are not caught in those actions and propagate out of them.
